turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi, what can I do for you?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hello! I want help with my premium subscription

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I love the benefits so much! I can't imagine how I lived without them

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Okay, what kind of hep did you need?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I really want to keep my subscription active but I am not sure how to pay the fee

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Can you help me figure this out?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: So you would like to pay your bill?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes I would

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Can I have your name?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I think the annual fee is due

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Alessandro Phoenix

turns.speaker: system_action
turns.text: Account has been pulled up for Alessandro Phoenix.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Okay, can I have your account ID and order ID?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: EPDWFLBDYY

turns.speaker: system_action
turns.text: Identity verification in progress ...

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Okay the amount is 99, how much did you want to pay today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I would like to pay all of it

turns.speaker: system_action
turns.text: Details of 99 have been entered.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Do you have your credit card number?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Can you use the card that I have on file?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Yes I can

turns.speaker: system_action
turns.text: Account has been updated with renew subscription.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Okay you are all set

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Oh great!

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Is there anything else I can do for you?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I am so happy to keep my subscription

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No, that was it

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Thanks for helping me!

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: No prblem, have a nice day
